title: Gas handling (degas + CHP vs pressurised reinjection)
question: How is the associated gas handled?

options.label: Gas handling: degas_use
options.notes: candidates: C1-3d, C2-2d, C3-2d, C5-3d, C6-2d, C8-3d; excluded by DesignGuard/verifier: C4-2d; top-ranked (LCOH ranking)

rationale: Selected based on the ranking-lowest-lcoh_per_mwh criterion among guard-passed options in economics. Option pressurised-reinject was rejected because it did not achieve the lowest lcoh_per_mwh as per the economics results in TR-013.
